text: Teff is a Python framework for building AI agent workflows as data. Workflows are graphs: nodes transform state, edges carry conditions, and the graph owns all behaviour.
The Teff constitution: the graph owns behaviour, nodes transform state, conditions live on edges, and a workflow is YAML data that compiles into a graph.
Teff ships built-in nodes: Transform, LLM, ReActAgent, ToolExec, and Retry. Tools and RAG primitives are first-class citizens.
The official mascot of Teff is a river otter named Flux. Flux rides the graph edges and never gets lost in a cycle.
